title: Government contracts that were really for UAP data, presented as war games

tellings.quote: And I would add that situation is complicated by the fact that in the past we already received contracts from the government to collect data on NAA.

plain: The government has quietly paid for UAP data, UAP being the official term for UFOs, under contracts dressed up as war games, according to James Valor of Skywatcher, a startup that tries to call up and record UFOs. He tells Michels his company "already received contracts from the government to collect data" on them in the early 2020s. If so, official interest is hidden under other labels.
